resources.string: Tap on a headline to bring up the article view, which shows more detail regarding the article; photo, brief description, link, and favourite button.\n\n The menu button, located at the left of the toolbar, can be used to navigate to "Favourites" (a list of your favourite articles) or to the settings (to change the RSS feed URL)

This view functions similarly to the feed, but is populated with local copies of the articles you\'ve favourited.\n\n Tap on a headline to bring up the article view, which shows more detail regarding the article; photo, brief description, link, and favourite button.

The article's photo, title, description, and link are displayed.

 Tapping on the link will open the article in your default web browser.

 The (un)favourite button can be used to add or remove an article from your favourites list.

Here you can change the RSS feed's URL, so that you can load your news from a different source.

 SET will store whatever is in the text box as the URL to load as a feed. It will also give you a brief period to revert the change via a Snackbar.

 CLEAR will remove whatever text is currently in the text box.

 If you want to revert to the default BBC News feed, ensure the text box is empty and hit SET.
